summary: Snap the fitness:db timeout-mask: the ci/checks/db LIVE-Postgres suite was deterministically/load-sensitively RED on the vitest 5000ms default testTimeout (and 10000ms hookTimeout) alone — a timeout-margin failure, not a functional bug. A deterministically-red gate MASKS real db regressions (fitness-mask class, memory choros-fitness-mask-unmask). Diagnosed as SYSTEMIC (not the 4 originally-observed files): under concurrent-CI DB load, whichever heavy PG-integration test happens to run slow tips over 5000ms — two independent full fitness:db runs failed a DIFFERENT set of files, all with 'Test timed out in 5000ms'. Cure = raise the timeout budget suite-wide in the root vitest.config.js + one genuine test-fixture efficiency fix.
approach: mixed (suite-wide timeout config + one batched write loop)

systemic_fix.change: Added testTimeout: 60000 and hookTimeout: 30000 to the root `test` block (shared by src unit suite + db suite; db suite runs via `vitest run --dir ci/checks/db` which uses this same root config).
systemic_fix.value_rationale: 60000 testTimeout gives real margin over the slowest LEGIT test observed live: seed-pack.test.ts AC-9 reset took 26153ms and AC-8 idempotency 16390ms (server startup + full HTTP applyPack round-trips; T-0140). 30000 was too tight for those under concurrent load. hookTimeout 30000 covers heavy beforeAll server-start hooks (rights-intents.db.test.ts imports src/server.js + listens; its hook exceeded the 10000ms default under load, cascading to 17 SKIPPED tests).
systemic_fix.why_cure_not_mask: A genuine regression is an ASSERTION failure, caught at ANY timeout; only a truly-hung test waits longer before failing. Raising the ceiling is harmless for the fast src unit suite (passing tests finish in ms; and the db tier is excluded from the default `vitest run` via the exclude list). No assertion touched.

per_file_efficiency_fix.change: FF-5/AC-15 seed loop: 1010 sequential single-row INSERT round-trips (1000 dispatched + 10 pending) collapsed into 2 multi-row INSERT...SELECT unnest() statements. Pure test-fixture seeding (no store/product function in the loop), same columns, same values, same row count — only round-trip count changes. Committed in 77cd68cf.
per_file_efficiency_fix.note: This is a real inefficiency fix (per brief preference (b)); it makes that test robustly fast regardless of timeout.

doc_files_note: doc-reconcile/doc-regen/doc-summary .db.test.ts: an earlier pass (commit 77cd68cf) added per-file vi.setConfig({testTimeout:60000}) overrides. Now FOLDED INTO the suite-wide default for a single source of truth — the vi.setConfig calls were removed and the explanatory comments retrained (they document why those files are heavy: they replicate the production per-page write loop over the WHOLE live-repo doc snapshot, some running runRegen/runReconcile twice). No behavior change: suite default 60000 >= the removed per-file 60000.

tipping_files_identified.note: Timeout victims vary run-to-run under load (this is the point — systemic). Observed across two full fitness:db runs + coordinator's run:

db_result.before_fail: systemic timeout-flake: run-1 8 failed / 1440 passed (doc-reconcile x7, doc-regen x1); run-2 5 failed / 1443 passed (T-0744, cross_app_ref_reconcile, report_page_render_ac6, seed-pack) — ALL 'Test timed out in 5000ms', different files each run
db_result.targeted_after_pass: 4 previously-failing files re-run with new config against real PG :55432 (choros_migrator) — 4 files passed / 0 failed, 89 tests passed / 0 failed: pgJobStore.integration.test.ts, inbox_claim_substitution.db.test.ts (12), seed-pack.test.ts (5; AC-9=26153ms, AC-8=16390ms), rights-intents.db.test.ts (17 — previously all SKIPPED via hook timeout, now run+pass)
db_result.full_suite_note: Full fitness:db (159 files) NOT re-run at coordinator instruction (machine under concurrent-agent load; orchestrator will run the solo pass). Targeted run demonstrates the cure on the exact tipping files.

assertions_note: Only timeout config (root vitest.config.js) and one test-fixture seed loop (pgOutbox, identical rows/values via unnest) changed. Every it()/expect() body is byte-unchanged. No test deleted or skipped; rights-intents' 17 SKIPPED were a hook-timeout cascade (NOT a describe.skip — grep confirms no .skip in the file), now un-skipped by the hookTimeout bump.

gates.frozen_checks_immutable: PASS — no ci/checks/*.sh gate script touched (only test files under ci/checks/db + root vitest.config.js)
